notes: Re-runs the SAME December gates with nothing retuned, to answer a question the earlier runs could not: when a signal shows FAIL, did it actually lose money? The prior module only recorded whether a rung was touched, so FAIL conflated a flat drift with a collapse. This run adds MFE, MAE, drawdown-before-peak and end-of-day result, all measured from the signal price on same-date forward bars as outcome labels only, and reports them split by rung result. March 2025 remains untouched and is refused fail-closed.
